'''Sabla-Mandibu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Council of Reconciliation/Legends|Council of Reconciliation]] and a renowned [[Jedi Seer|Seer]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Serving at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in the years preceding the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], Master Mandibu was an expert at analyzing [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]]. Among her many contributions to the Order during her years of service was her authorship of several chapters of the Temple guidebook titled, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. Writing down her knowledge of the [[Force power/Legends|Sense and Alter abilities]] and their application with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Master Mandibu left a lasting impression on future generations through her words.

==Biography==
Like all Jedi of the era, Master Mandibu served the Order during the [[New Sith Wars]] and helped rebuild the [[Jedi academy]] after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]]. Following the war, Master Mandibu was appointed to sit on the [[Council of Reconciliation/Legends|Council of Reconciliation]], working as liaison between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and several different political factions.<ref name="TJP" />

When her fellow Masters proposed that a guidebook to the life of the Jedi be written, Master Mandibu agreed to work on the project, contributing three chapters. Hoping to emphasize the virtue of the [[Jedi Consular]]s as well as give a detailed description of the Sense and Alter abilities of the Jedi, Master Mandibu's teachings were passed down in the tome for several generations.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
While it did not make it into the finished edition, [[Daniel Wallace]], author of [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], released a list detailing the genders and species of each of the authors of the in-universe ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. Master Mandibu is revealed to be a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]].<ref name="JCF" />

Sabla-Mandibu's name is a [[tuckerization]] of Mandy Bulat, friend of author [[Daniel Wallace]] and former staff member at Star Wars news site [[TheForce.net]].<ref name="Blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-2.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 2 of 4)}}</ref>
